scope: 37-source, 100000-candidate research pool; operational collection review, not blanket legal or training certification
global_rules: Reuse this source review unless the source revision, terms, intended use or access route changes.
No manual per-sample approval queue. Use automated validation and source-derived tagging.
Preserve the current 35-source quotas; user authorizes replacing or forfeiting genuinely blocked sources via a recorded rebalance, never silent substitution.
Missing implementation, dates, genre checks or overlap audits are not new user-approval requests.
Candidate collection/publication does not establish commercial training clearance.
Mixed-license sources require automatic record metadata filters, not human approval for every record.
Only concrete access/terms decisions requiring user knowledge should be escalated; continue all independent sources.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg, with Standard Ebooks preferred for matching editions
sources.terms_summary: US public-domain texts; exceptions and jurisdiction matter
sources.selection_rule: Use public-domain subset and allowed bulk mirror; retain book IDs and source notice; exclude protected PG19 families.

sources.name: WritingPrompts original 2018 release
sources.terms_summary: Original 2018 research release; underlying story rights unresolved
sources.selection_rule: Use original train.wp_target only, pair prompts as metadata, never generated samples; retain split/line and prompt-family IDs.

sources.name: SCP Foundation prose tales
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA 3.0 text with attribution; third-party asset exceptions
sources.selection_rule: English narrative tales only; retain authors, page/canon IDs and pre-2022 revision evidence; omit images and containment-template boilerplate.

sources.name: Wikisource proofread short fiction
sources.terms_summary: Public-domain or compatible free-license works; translations can differ
sources.selection_rule: Main namespace literary prose; preserve work-specific copyright tag, edition and translator; deduplicate Gutenberg overlap.

sources.name: PMC Open Access commercial-reuse subset
sources.terms_summary: Article-specific OA licenses; PMC access alone is insufficient
sources.selection_rule: Use pinned OA subset with explicit allowed license; retain PMCID/DOI; supported bulk services or established subset mirror.

sources.name: arXiv full texts with suitable article licenses
sources.terms_summary: Per-version licenses; default arXiv distribution license is not general reuse permission
sources.selection_rule: Select explicitly compatible open licenses from the pinned subset; retain version/date and paper-family identity.

sources.name: Common Pile licensed peS2o subset
sources.terms_summary: Common Pile openly licensed peS2o subset; preserve per-paper license
sources.selection_rule: Use pinned licensed subset; preserve paper IDs/DOIs and remove duplicates with arXiv/PMC/ACL.

sources.name: ACL-owned proceedings from 2016–2021
sources.terms_summary: ACL-owned 2016 onward CC BY 4.0; third-party proceedings differ
sources.selection_rule: 2016–2021 ACL-owned papers; exclude existing protected local paper families; preserve anthology ID/DOI.

sources.name: English Wikipedia historical article revisions
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA; version and attribution information retained
sources.selection_rule: Main namespace articles only; retain revision IDs and contributors/history link; no talk-page routing into reference.

sources.name: Pressbooks openly licensed textbook editions
sources.terms_summary: Per-book licenses; selected mirror restricts to PD, CC BY or CC BY-SA
sources.selection_rule: Preserve book/section license and author; obtain additional eligible books from same source after current mirror shortfall.

sources.name: English Wikibooks historical chapters
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA text; preserve applicable revision license
sources.selection_rule: Main namespace prose; group chapters under book; retain attribution/history.

sources.name: Amazon Review Data 2018
sources.terms_summary: Original 2018 research release; underlying review rights unresolved
sources.selection_rule: Original full per-category review files, not ratings-only, descriptions or newer Amazon releases; product/rating diversity and user/product grouping.

sources.name: Yelp Open Dataset historical reviews
sources.terms_summary: Academic-use eligibility and no-third-party-sharing restrictions in current agreement
sources.selection_rule: Do not collect, publish or generate mirrors. Prior source/access restrictions preserved in plan-history.

sources.name: Stanford Large Movie Review Dataset
sources.terms_summary: Original 2011 Stanford research release; underlying review rights unresolved
sources.selection_rule: Training and unlabeled originals only; exclude official test; preserve original review URL/movie grouping and original HTML breaks.

sources.name: OpinRank hotel and car reviews
sources.terms_summary: UCI states CC BY 4.0; upstream review rights remain recorded as unresolved
sources.selection_rule: Original hotel/car review files; balance types/cities; retain author/date/review IDs and avoid concatenating duplicate fields.

sources.name: Stack Exchange non-programming answers
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA 2.5/3.0/4.0 according to contribution date
sources.selection_rule: Use approved nontechnical sites; retain post/revision/author attribution; whole thread grouping; respect dump access requirements.

sources.name: Stack Exchange technical explanations
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA 2.5/3.0/4.0 according to contribution date
sources.selection_rule: Use agreed technical sites; preserve thread grouping and source tags; current collector excludes Stack Overflow itself.

sources.name: Ubuntu IRC historical conversations
sources.terms_summary: Common Pile source documents public-domain archived logs
sources.selection_rule: Pre-2022 channel/day records; extract human turns and filter known bots/system notices; retain channel/day and speaker grouping.

sources.name: Wikipedia human discussion threads
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA discussion contributions
sources.selection_rule: Article-talk namespace 1; retain revision/thread IDs and attribution; do not use article namespace to fill this source.

sources.name: Common Pile Creative Commons Common Crawl
sources.terms_summary: Only domains/pages with supported text-license evidence; raw metadata gap unresolved
sources.selection_rule: Implement pre-2022 crawl snapshot plus verified domain/license mapping; missing raw metadata.license is not evidence of a license. Domain cap and category routing remain automatic rules.

sources.name: EFF historical Deeplinks articles
sources.terms_summary: EFF original material CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted
sources.selection_rule: Original pre-2022 Deeplinks prose; retain byline/version evidence; omit external republications, quoted third-party blocks and widgets.

sources.name: Foodista narrative food writing
sources.terms_summary: Common Pile documents CC BY source content
sources.selection_rule: Original article/recipe prose with dates and bylines; preserve faithful HTML extraction; distinguish appended comments and remove automated comments.

sources.name: Wikivoyage travel prose
sources.terms_summary: CC BY-SA text with attribution
sources.selection_rule: Main namespace travel prose; retain page/revision IDs; additional eligible same-source material needed after mirror shortfall.

sources.name: Global Voices original English news
sources.terms_summary: CC BY original text; third-party media excluded
sources.selection_rule: Preserve author and canonical story URL; pre-2022 historical evidence; exclude copied third-party media/text beyond permitted source content.

sources.name: Voice of America original reporting
sources.terms_summary: Exclusively VOA-produced material public domain; AP/AFP/Reuters are excluded
sources.selection_rule: Select VOA bylined originals only; automatic wire-service exclusions; retain dates/URLs and revision evidence.

sources.name: Wikinews archived reporting
sources.terms_summary: Pre-2005 public domain; 2005–2024 CC BY 2.5; newer material CC BY 4.0
sources.selection_rule: Only pre-2022 articles for this mix; retain correct period license, source attribution and article revision.

sources.name: SciDev.Net original science and development journalism
sources.terms_summary: Official pages differ between CC BY 2.0 and 3.0; original text open, exceptions exist
sources.selection_rule: Retain article-level notice/version and author; exclude third-party documents; record policy-version discrepancy, not an invented uniform license.

sources.name: OANC contributed Slate journalism
sources.terms_summary: OANC explicitly permits unrestricted use and redistribution
sources.selection_rule: Use OANC Slate component only, not a fresh Slate scrape or full ANC Second Release; preserve article IDs/dates.

sources.name: ASAP 2.0 original training essays
sources.terms_summary: Official original training release CC BY 4.0
sources.selection_rule: Original training essays only; preserve essay/prompt IDs; collection dates honestly unverified; automatic PERSUADE and protected-family overlap exclusions.

sources.name: ELLIPSE original reliable training essays
sources.terms_summary: Official release CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
sources.selection_rule: Reliable original train essays only; exclude existing local evaluation essays and related prompt/student families before selection; keep noncommercial status.

sources.name: British Academic Written English
sources.terms_summary: Publisher specifies noncommercial research, conditions of use and OTA registration
sources.selection_rule: Do not collect, publish or generate mirrors. Prior source/access restrictions preserved in plan-history.

sources.name: PERSUADE original essays with version-specific rights
sources.terms_summary: Version 2.0 repository says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; separate publisher page says CC BY 4.0
sources.selection_rule: Use official version-2 training release under its stated restrictive terms; retain conflicting evidence; no test set; deduplicate ASAP/student/prompt families.

sources.name: GovReport original CRS and GAO reports
sources.terms_summary: Publisher dataset CC BY 4.0; 2021 corpus
sources.selection_rule: Original report column from training split; never paired summaries; preserve shard/row/hash when agency IDs missing and record mapping pending.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Board reports and policy prose
sources.terms_summary: Board-authored site information public domain unless otherwise indicated
sources.selection_rule: Pre-2022 Board prose only; exclude attributed non-Board material, images and logos; preserve document date/author/URL.

sources.name: World Bank openly licensed reports
sources.terms_summary: OKR contains CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-ND and other licenses
sources.selection_rule: Select agreed openly licensed subset (CC BY/CC BY IGO); retain per-work license and required attribution; no blanket OKR license assignment.

sources.name: OANC ICIC professional correspondence
sources.terms_summary: OANC explicitly permits unrestricted use and redistribution
sources.selection_rule: Only ICIC fundraising/letters component; preserve original document boundaries and IDs; check finite 245-file supply against passage quota without duplication.
